subject: You've been invited
heading: You've been invited
body: Hi {{name}}, an admin has created an account for you. Accept the invitation with the button below: it confirms this email address. Then sign in with the temporary password below; you will choose your own password before anything else.
expiryNote: This invitation link works for {{days}} days. If it has expired, sign in with the temporary password anyway: you will get a new email with a link that confirms your address.
ignoreFooter: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.
